original_test_intent: Complete exactly 100 true warm reboot cycles and demonstrate reliable boot plus stable OS, PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA identity/health on every cycle.
original_method: Pin an approved warm-reset mechanism and GB300 guide revision, drain workloads for the 24-hour window, run a durable 100-cycle state machine with independent console, collect full per-cycle endpoint and error evidence, stop on first unsafe anomaly and preserve the failed state.
manual_activity: An operator approves and monitors the 24-hour 100-cycle plan, maintains independent recovery, reviews every failure boundary and authorizes continuation or restore; a five-cycle smoke is labeled preflight only.
required_inputs: Approved GB300 NVL72 validation-guide revision replacing NVOnline TBD
Platform-specific true warm-reset interface and evidence distinguishing it from DC/AC
Exactly 100-cycle schedule, boot/inter-cycle timeouts and resume/abort policy
Workload drain, storage flush, data state and maintenance-window approval
Expected OS/boot identity, PCIe BDF/device/link manifest
Expected MCTP endpoints/EIDs/routes and health transactions
Expected SSIF request/response and FPGA device/version/status matrix
Complete error/thermal/power/storage limits and independent console/recovery
Secure BMC/OS secret provider and sufficient artifact storage
safety_requirements: Do not call five representative cycles completion of the 100-cycle source
Do not assume chassis power cycle is warm without reset-class approval
Never embed passwords or disable host verification
Persist cycle index and evidence atomically so restart cannot skip or double-count cycles
Stop and preserve first boot timeout, missing/downtrained PCIe device, MCTP/SSIF/FPGA mismatch, AER/DPC, storage/data, thermal/power or recovery degradation
No automatic retry or silent resumption after a failed cycle
agent_execution_scope: Verify guide, reset method, endpoint manifests and runner readiness
Collect read-only comprehensive baseline and preflight one approved smoke cycle if requested
Execute the approved 100-cycle runner only after confirmation, checkpointing every cycle
Compare OS/PCIe/MCTP/SSIF/FPGA and error/health evidence per cycle
Perform no shortcut, ambiguous power cycle, failure retry, evidence overwrite, workload restore or verdict
engineer_actions: Supply guide and approve true warm method, 100-cycle schedule and recovery
Define all endpoint/health/error criteria and denominator
Review any failed cycle before continuation and prohibit hidden reruns
Review all 100 immutable results and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient: it executes only 5/100 cycles, may use a cold BMC power cycle, exposes secrets/disables host verification, and checks only uptime/AER count instead of required MCTP, SSIF and FPGA stability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a secure durable runner for exactly 100 approved warm resets with state-based timeouts and full per-cycle OS/PCIe/MCTP/SSIF/FPGA plus error/health collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exactly 100 warm reboots, all named health domains and 30/1,440-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL 100-CYCLE WARM-RESET QUALIFICATION PENDING GUIDE AND RESET-CLASS CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store one immutable result object per cycle with reset cause, boot milestones and normalized endpoint manifests; atomically advance the counter only after evidence passes completeness checks, and halt on the first anomaly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative warm semantics, guide revision, complete multi-interface evidence, durable counting and stop/recovery controls while rejecting the five-cycle substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Five cycles provide only smoke evidence and cannot establish the stated 100-cycle endurance. AER counts do not represent MCTP, SSIF or FPGA identity/communication stability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated reboots can expose intermittent failures that vanish after another reset. Automatic retry would censor the very reliability signal being measured, so the first failed cycle and its unmodified logs must remain authoritative.

project_override_considerations: A staged 5-cycle preflight may precede the run but does not reduce the 100-cycle denominator. Any guide-approved stop/resume or excluded cycle policy must be explicit and cannot turn a failed or missing cycle into pass.
expected_evidence: Secure runner version/hash and atomic cycle ledger numbered 1-100
Per-cycle reset/boot/OS plus full PCIe link/device, MCTP endpoint/route, SSIF and FPGA evidence
Per-cycle AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/storage/thermal/power output and first-failure preservation
Independent 100-cycle completeness calculation, no-shortcut/no-auto-retry audit, final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master explicitly requires 100 warm reboots and five named stability domains, while the DeepSeek command intentionally runs only five cycles and records only uptime/AER counts. It also uses `chassis power cycle` without proving warm-reset semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The endurance purpose is clear and can be executed once the guide, warm mechanism and per-domain criteria are approved. Static review preserves missing inputs without accepting the shortcut.

engineering_decision_pending: Resolve Functionality row 1926 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00465-V004: provide the approved GB300 NVL72 guide revision and true warm-reset mechanism, confirm the full 100-cycle denominator and define per-cycle OS/PCIe/MCTP/SSIF/FPGA criteria, stop/resume and recovery; five-cycle smoke/AER-only evidence must remain preflight and not replace coverage.
review_improvement: Restores all 100 cycles and every named interface, prevents warm/cold ambiguity and adds durable per-cycle accounting that preserves intermittent failures.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reliability stress is defined by sequence completeness and first-failure fidelity. Reducing 100 to five changes the probability of observing intermittent reset and enumeration defects, while retrying a failed cycle hides them. A durable ledger tied to normalized PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA identities ensures that successful OS boot cannot mask partial platform recovery.
